datasets.name: pledgs
datasets.sql:
SELECT id,  description
  FROM cm_pledges
order by id

datasets.name: ReportData
datasets.sql:
select 
     p.dateofconclusion as opendate,
     nvl(p.duedatelastcontract,p.duedatefirstcontract) as closedate,
     p.creditlineamount,
     p.annualyinterestrate,
     cust.name as custname,
     cust.id as CustID,
     cm_common.accountnumber_get(acc.contractaccid) as ContractAccNO,
     cm_common.get_accountbalance(acc.contractaccid) as BalAcc  ,
     h.rest,
     h.interestrest,
     h.duerest,
     h.dueinterestrest,
     h.stopcalcdate,
     h.reserveid,
     h.duereserveid,
     cm_utils.Get_CreditPaymentgreatDate(p.id,p.duedatefirstcontract) as payamt
   from cm_portfolio p,
        cm_sb_customers cust,
        cm_accounts acc,
        cm_curr_state h
   where 
      p.boorowerid = cust.id and
      p.id = acc.creditid and
      p.id  = h.creditid(+)

datasets.name: Reserves
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, percent||' - '|| description as descr
  FROM CM_RESERVES
  order by id

datasets.name: DueReserves
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, percent||' - '|| description as descr
  FROM CM_RESERVES
  order by id

datasets.name: Customers
datasets.sql:
select id,
       name,
       id||' - '||name as Kod
from
   cm_sb_customers
where  EXISTS  (select boorowerid from cm_portfolio)
